title: Secret
description: Canonical Secret contract per DEVOS-SPEC-028. Secret entries carry identifiers and metadata ONLY. Raw values MUST NEVER appear in any manifest, schema instance, export, log, or event; custody belongs exclusively to the Security Engine defined in DEVOS-SPEC-036.

id.description: Stable identifier used by consumers to reference the Secret.

description.description: What this Secret is for, without revealing its value.

rotationPolicyHint.description: Advisory rotation intent; enforcement belongs to the Security Engine.

expiryHint.description: Advisory expiry intent; enforcement belongs to the Security Engine.

$comment: additionalProperties:false rejects any field carrying a raw secret value, implementing the absolute rules of DEVOS-SPEC-028 at the schema layer.
